description.value: Off Main is a brunch and lunch restaurant in downtown Courtenay that leans into fresh local ingredients and creative, funky takes on classic dishes. The menu rotates frequently and features house-smoked salmon, Mexican-braised beef birria, pork belly benedicts, and cocktails alongside the usual brunch fare. It is a solid sit-down refuel stop for cyclists passing through the Comox Valley.
